RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat: No Regime Change in India

RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat stated that there will be no "regime change" in India, adding that attempts are being made to create situations similar to those in Bangladesh and France. Bhagwat made these remarks after performing 'Shastra Puja'.
